title: Turning Off Auto-Pluralization For SEO Templates (Adding An Extra "S") | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Turning Off Auto-Pluralization For SEO Templates (Adding An Extra "S") Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000027134 Overview Automatic pluralization (the system adding an "s" within SEO templates) can be disabled for a site. Steps Navigate to Admin > Settings > Advanced Settings . Search for disable_plural_text . Switch the setting to ON to turn off pluralization. Click Save Changes . NOTE: The setting name is disable_plural_text , but it is switched ON to disable pluralization, not off. The ON state activates the "disable" behavior. Default Website Language When the Default Website Language is set to a language other than English, and the Use same language for text labels and email templates option is enabled, the system automatically disables auto-pluralization to ensure accurate text display. Related Reading Additional details on available variables are covered in the " Understanding SEO Variables " article.
